name: Sophie
quote: A kinder tomorrow starts with small moments.
blurb: Draws in the window of the flower stall. Wants something small to sit beside the sketchbook.

name: Emma
quote: A calm mind is a happy home.
blurb: Reads with headphones on for hours. Her flat is warm and far too quiet.

name: Mia
blurb: Photographs every animal she meets. Runs the photo walk in the park.

name: Leo
quote: Good company makes every journey better.
blurb: Out on the trails before sunrise. Keeps looking back for someone who is not there yet.

name: Noah
quote: A better world for our four-legged friends.
blurb: Works late with one hand on the keyboard. The other hand is free.

name: Alex
blurb: Cooks too much food on purpose. Has been saving a bowl for somebody.
